Name: Spoopy Bombay Cat Recolor (ContentPatcher)
Author: WithoutGravitas
Description:
[size=5]This is a ContentPatcher mod that recolors the cat into an orange-eyed and black Bombay. 

Installation Instructions:[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Spoopy Bombay Cat Recolor
Manifest.Description: Recolors the standard cat to a spoopy orange-eyed black Bombay.
